tokens.name: ink-000
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: the viewer letterbox, video background, behind sheets and overlays.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page background of the results pages (home, event, standings, model, analysis).

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Cards, tables and solid panels on surface-100.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Raised: row hover, inputs, segmented-control track, chart plot area, position boxes.

tokens.name: surface-400
tokens.usage: Selected or pressed rows; the focused car's row in the timing tower.

tokens.name: hud-panel
tokens.usage: HUD panels over the 3D scene (86% opaque). Desktop may add blur-hud; phones never blur.

tokens.name: hud-panel-solid
tokens.usage: HUD panels over busy scenery: phone tower sheet, transport bar, toasts.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and inside panels. Decorative only, never the only cue.

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Outlines of cards, panels and the HUD.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, unselected toggles, chart axes, outline badges. 3:1 or more on surface-100 to surface-300.

tokens.name: text-100
tokens.usage: Chalk. Primary text and every numeral, on all surfaces and HUD panels.

tokens.name: text-200
tokens.usage: Secondary text: provider, units, sub-labels, table cells that are not the point of the row.

tokens.name: text-300
tokens.usage: Tertiary: column heads, micro labels, timestamps, footnotes. 4.5:1 on surface-100 to surface-400 and on hud-panel.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls only. Never carries information.

tokens.name: fill-chalk
tokens.usage: Fill of primary buttons, selected segments, the leader's position box and the focused label.

tokens.name: on-chalk
tokens.usage: Text on fill-chalk and on every entry colour (chips, labels). 5:1 or more on all twelve entry colours.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid outline with 2px offset on every focusable element. 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: timing-fastest
tokens.usage: Overall fastest lap or sector: text, pip and sector cell. Always with the time or 'FL', never colour alone.

tokens.name: timing-personal
tokens.usage: Personal best lap or sector (green sector).

tokens.name: timing-slower
tokens.usage: Sector slower than the car's own best (yellow sector).

tokens.name: status-dnf
tokens.usage: Retirement and crash: DNF badge fill (on-chalk text), incident pins, timeline markers. Always with the word DNF or the cross glyph.

tokens.name: status-dnf-tint
tokens.usage: Row tint behind a car for the 3 s after it retires; then the row drops to opacity-out.

tokens.name: status-warn
tokens.usage: Track-limit warnings, deleted laps, time penalties, trial caveats: badge fill (on-chalk text), pins, outline.

tokens.name: status-warn-tint
tokens.usage: Background of the caveat banner and of a penalised row.

tokens.name: delta-ahead
tokens.usage: Delta charts and chips: faster or ahead of the reference car. Always signed (minus sign).

tokens.name: delta-behind
tokens.usage: Delta charts and chips: slower or behind the reference car. Always signed (plus sign).

tokens.name: telemetry-speed
tokens.usage: Speed ring round the telemetry dial, on a fixed 0-350 km/h scale.

tokens.name: telemetry-throttle
tokens.usage: Throttle arc (left of the dial, labelled THROTTLE) and throttle lane (THR); never overlaid on brake.

tokens.name: telemetry-brake
tokens.usage: Brake arc (right of the dial, labelled BRAKE) and brake lane (BRK), in its own lane under throttle.

tokens.name: telemetry-steer
tokens.usage: Steering: the notch at the top of the telemetry dial's wheel.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Grid lines in charts. Decorative.

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Axis labels and tick text.

tokens.name: chart-cursor
tokens.usage: The playhead line that follows the focused car in charts and on the map.

tokens.name: entry-01

tokens.name: entry-10

tokens.name: entry-11

tokens.name: entry-12

tokens.name: entry-none
tokens.usage: An entry without a colour slot (more than twelve in one event).

tokens.name: body-clay
tokens.usage: Bodywork for Anthropic entries. 3D material only; never UI text or fills. The entry colour rides on the livery stripe, so two cars of one provider still differ.

tokens.name: body-silver
tokens.usage: Bodywork for OpenAI entries. 3D material only; never UI text or fills. The entry colour rides on the livery stripe, so two cars of one provider still differ.

tokens.name: body-cobalt

tokens.name: body-pearl

tokens.name: body-saffron

tokens.name: body-graphite

tokens.name: world-grass-b

tokens.name: world-gravel

tokens.name: world-barrier-a
tokens.usage: Barrier panels, light. 3D scene only.

tokens.name: world-barrier-b
tokens.usage: Barrier panels, blue. 3D scene only.

tokens.name: world-sky
tokens.usage: Sky and clear colour. 3D scene only.

tokens.name: world-sector

tokens.name: world-barrier-top

tokens.name: world-checker
